source: Mobbin web screen search, Oct 2026 (about 45 searches' worth of dashboard, chart, filter and state screens). Each entry is one screen or a closely related set, with what it does and the lesson drawn. Image URLs are not stored (they expire); open mobbin_url on Mobbin.
description: Real-product evidence behind the dataviz rules. verdict: 'adopt' = a pattern worth copying; 'watch-out' = a pattern that breaks a rule, kept as a counter-example. `rules` lists the DV-* ids the entry supports. These are observations of other companies' UI used for pattern research, not a license to copy their visual design.

entries.screen: Daily activity line chart with dots and a small tooltip
entries.observation: A smoothed spline dips toward zero between two real points and overshoots near the peaks. Title plus a date-range subtitle and a compact tooltip (date, value) are good.
entries.lesson: Smoothing invents values between points. Use linear or monotone. Keep the title and period subtitle and the minimal tooltip.

entries.screen: Monitoring dashboard with Group by and Last 7 days
entries.observation: Three large cards are flat zero lines with one spike. Legend swatches sit below, each card has an expand icon, and one range control scopes all cards.
entries.lesson: Large cards of mostly flat zero waste the page and blur missing data with real zero. Share one range control, but give sparse data its own state.

entries.screen: Analytics with date presets popover, KPI tiles and hatched bar
entries.observation: Preset rows (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Year to date, All time) beside a two-month calendar. KPI tiles carry '100% vs previous'. The in-progress day is a hatched bar. Export CSV sits above the tables.
entries.lesson: Presets first, custom range second. Hatch the incomplete period. Always name the comparison. Offer export.

entries.screen: Reporting dashboard with area and bar widgets
entries.observation: Endpoint labels on the area chart (0, 0, 8, 13), a footer saying '1 Filter, Tasks in 1 project' and a 'See all' link. The y-axis title is clipped to 'Task count, in numb...'.
entries.lesson: Disclose chart-level scope in the footer, link to detail, label the endpoints only. Don't let axis titles truncate.

entries.screen: Stats grid of sparkline tiles with compared-to controls
entries.observation: A row of controls (range, 'compared to' range, granularity, product filter) above a 3-up grid of tiles. Each tile has a label, value, delta chip and a small line with two axis labels.
entries.lesson: Put range, comparison and grain together in one row. Tiles with value, delta and a sparkline are the right unit for 3 to 6 headline numbers.

entries.screen: Dark analytics cards: Net cashflow, Income, Spending
entries.observation: Each card header has the title with a chevron (drill-in), the value, 'This month' and a delta. The line turns dashed for the unfinished part of the month. Axis labels sit on the right.
entries.lesson: Card anatomy of title, value, delta, plot. Dashed for not-yet-happened. A chevron in the title signals drill-down.

entries.screen: Filter by period modal with Apply to all charts
entries.observation: A calendar range picker with an 'Apply to all charts' checkbox and a Done button.
entries.lesson: When a filter can be local or global, make the scope an explicit choice and default to global.

entries.screen: Traffic Analytics summary and trend
entries.observation: A KPI strip with colored deltas, metric tabs that switch the trend chart, a crosshair tooltip with value and range, a pale confidence band, a dotted forecast tail, per-card Export, and a year-over-year chart below.
entries.lesson: Hero KPI row, then primary trend, then comparison. Show forecasts dotted and ranges as a band. Metric tabs let one chart serve many KPIs.

entries.screen: Dark board dashboard with pie and colored bars
entries.observation: A 4-slice pie and a bar chart where each of five bars is a different color (green, yellow, orange, red, gray). A card menu offers Edit and Delete.
entries.lesson: Per-bar hues on one series burn the color channel. Status meaning (complete, overdue) is fine only if each also has a label or icon, and red beside green is a CVD trap. Use one hue plus text labels.

entries.screen: Traffic with KPI tabs, hourly toggle and a marker on every point
entries.observation: KPI tiles act as tabs (selected one outlined) and drive the chart below. An 'Hourly' dropdown sets grain. Every point carries a hollow marker, which gets noisy on 48 points.
entries.lesson: KPI-as-tab works when selected state is clear. Show markers only for sparse series or on hover.

entries.screen: Home with preceding-period comparison
entries.observation: A solid current-period line and a dotted 'Preceding period' line with line-key legend entries, and a card footer link 'View reports snapshot'.
entries.lesson: Overlay the comparison as a muted dotted series with a line-key legend. Each card ends with a path to detail.

entries.screen: Usage cards: big number over a bar chart with hover band
entries.observation: Each card: title with an arrow, a large number, a date range, and a short bar chart with only two gridlines. The hovered bar gets a pale band and a tooltip with a color key. Page states 'All analytics are based on UTC'.
entries.lesson: A sparse, quiet card is enough. Hover bands help hit the bar. State the timezone.

entries.screen: Main dashboard board
entries.observation: A board mixing a KPI card, a funnel, a weekly line, a text card that explains what 'User Engagement' means, and a flow diagram. 'Updated less than a minute ago' and a TV mode.
entries.lesson: A text card in a dashboard is legitimate editorial context. Show freshness. Keep the count of cards modest.

entries.screen: Three stacked daily line charts with a shared crosshair
entries.observation: Sessions, views and copies by day. One vertical crosshair runs through all three at the same date, and a tooltip lists all three values with bold values.
entries.lesson: Small multiples with a shared crosshair let a reader compare without a second axis.

entries.screen: Graph comparison with end-of-line value tags and series list
entries.observation: Multiple series with end-of-line value tags, a left list of series with color keys and remove buttons, a hover tooltip listing all series, keyboard shortcuts to cycle timeframes. Below: a series table with min, average, max, a sparkline and change.
entries.lesson: Color follows the entity in the list, the chart and the table. Series chips are the legend and the control. A table beneath is the table twin.

entries.screen: Chart editor with colored data-label backgrounds
entries.observation: Every point on three lines carries a boxed label on a colored background. Labels overlap near the peak.
entries.lesson: Labeling every point creates collisions. Label the end and the extreme.

entries.screen: In-worksheet chart builder
entries.observation: A single full-height bar fills its band and a grouped chart fills the whole plot with two saturated blocks. The builder panel for type, data and appearance is clear.
entries.lesson: Cap bar thickness and leave air. The type, data and appearance panel structure is a good builder pattern.

entries.screen: Income vs Expenses with a tabbed tooltip
entries.observation: The tooltip has tabs (Trend, Top transactions, Top contacts), a delta versus last period, and a color key per row. Bars sit above and below a zero baseline.
entries.lesson: A tooltip can hold a drill-in when it persists and is keyboard reachable. Keep the first tab to the plain readout.

entries.screen: Click-rate chart with benchmark and your-average lines
entries.observation: A headline '46.2% Average click rate' above the chart, two labeled reference lines ('Benchmark', 'Your average'), a tooltip on the peak, and a footnote explaining how the benchmark was built.
entries.lesson: Label reference lines directly and explain how the benchmark is computed.

entries.screen: S&P 500 heatmap treemap
entries.observation: A treemap sized by market cap, colored on a red to green scale with a small -3% to +3% key, and a hover card with the % change.
entries.lesson: Good: the scale key. Watch out: the red and green pair fails for common CVD. Use blue and orange or add a sign and label on each tile.

entries.screen: Dashboard edit mode with variables and auto-refresh
entries.observation: A side panel with auto-refresh (5 minutes) and dashboard variables ({{start_date}}, {{category_id}}), and a donut with the total in the center on a sibling screen.
entries.lesson: Auto-refresh and variables belong to the dashboard, set in edit mode. Donut with a center total is the right glance form.

entries.screen: Report skeleton
entries.observation: Grey blocks matching the final layout: title lines, a filter row, a large plot block and table rows with a header rule.
entries.lesson: A skeleton that matches the final geometry prevents layout shift.

entries.screen: Empty dashboards with a preview
entries.observation: A dashed panel with a small illustration of what a dashboard looks like, a sentence on how to add charts, and a learn-more link.
entries.lesson: For 'not set up', show what the finished thing looks like and give the first action.

entries.screen: Full-page logo spinner
entries.observation: A centered logo and 'Loading' over an empty shell.
entries.lesson: A full-page spinner says nothing about what's coming and flashes on every navigation. Use skeletons.

entries.screen: Widget with a missing axis
entries.observation: 'The x-axis is missing a value. Configure widget' inside the card, with a side panel showing widget type, X and Y axis, bar color, and toggles for Legends and Tooltips.
entries.lesson: Name the missing config and open the fix in place.

entries.screen: Dashboard with a centered spinner
entries.observation: The page chrome loads, then a single spinner sits where the widgets will go.
entries.lesson: A spinner for an area that will hold many cards gives no structure. Use a card skeleton.

entries.screen: Observability home with Add your first chart
entries.observation: A dashed placeholder with an 'Add your first chart' button, with refresh, a range select ('Last 7 days') and source select above it.
entries.lesson: A dashed drop slot with one action is a good empty dashboard. The controls are visible before there is data.

entries.screen: Collecting Data state
entries.observation: A ring with a dash, 'Collecting Data', 'Check back later once your website has had more traffic', a definition of the experience score, and dashes for CLS, TTFB, FCP, LCP and INP.
entries.lesson: Say it is collecting, define the metric, show placeholders instead of zeros.

entries.screen: Dashboard editor grid with Add widget
entries.observation: A faint grid of drop slots with 'Add widget, Click to add your first widget' and Save and Cancel in the header.
entries.lesson: Visible grid slots make a customizable layout legible in edit mode.

entries.screen: Web Analytics with not enough data
entries.observation: Filter chips ('Site is in ...', 'Exclude bots equals Yes') above an illustration and 'There is not enough data for Web Analytics right now. Check back after more visitors have visited your website.'
entries.lesson: Keep filters as chips. Explain the threshold. Don't draw empty axes.

entries.screen: Report needs more data
entries.observation: 'It looks like more data is needed to display this report. Configure outcomes data.' with the link inline.
entries.lesson: Put the fix in the sentence as a link.

entries.screen: Query table with sparkline columns
entries.observation: Grey axisless sparklines in count and latency columns, and a 'Show sparklines' checkbox in the View options menu.
entries.lesson: Sparklines in a table are muted and axisless, and optional via a column menu.

entries.screen: Token table with direction-colored sparklines
entries.observation: Green and red sparklines per row, with a triangle and signed percentage in the change columns.
entries.lesson: Color plus triangle plus sign makes direction readable without color. Keep the sparkline in the same pair.

entries.screen: Search trends table
entries.observation: Keyword rows with a small curve and weekly, monthly and yearly change as signed percentages.
entries.lesson: A trend table is a table plus a sparkline column. Don't make it a chart.

entries.screen: Category indices multi-line, heatmap and market table
entries.observation: About ten colored lines with legend chips that toggle each, a sibling treemap, and a market table with 24h trend sparklines.
entries.lesson: Legend chips as toggles are good. Ten hues on one plot are not: past about five, facet or isolate.

entries.screen: Metric detail drawer with target and data points
entries.observation: Drawer with a line chart, a labeled 'Target: 15' reference line, then a data points table with date and value rows, import CSV and add data point.
entries.lesson: Metric detail = chart, target and the table of record. The table is the accessible twin and the edit surface.

entries.screen: Chart type picker with 22 tiles
entries.observation: A dark panel offering Area, Auto, Bar, Bubble, Bullet, Bubble pack, Column, Dot, Funnel, Gauge, Table, KPI, Line, Pie, Picto, Parallel sets, Radar, Sparkline, Relational, Treemap, Sunburst, Waterfall and Word cloud.
entries.lesson: Twenty-plus types is a menu for people who already know. Offer 5 valid types.

entries.screen: Chart view settings with five chart types
entries.observation: An icon row: vertical bar, horizontal bar, line, donut, number. Settings for X axis, sort, omit zero values, Y axis, group by, cumulative, range, reference line and color.
entries.lesson: Five types is enough. Settings are the data model: what to show, sort, group, range, reference line.

entries.screen: Chart cell config with Chart and Table toggle
entries.observation: A Chart | Table toggle in the card header, Data and Style tabs, x-axis sort options, color by, faceting and a tooltips toggle.
entries.lesson: A Chart | Table toggle in the header is the cheapest table twin.

entries.screen: Metric explorer with time grain and range arrows
entries.observation: Under the chart: Week, Month, Quarter, 6M, Year, 2Y, 5Y, Custom, with prev and next arrows and 'Last 12 months'. A right panel has Breakdown, Filter, Metrics, Compare.
entries.lesson: Grain tabs plus prev/next arrows give fast time navigation. Group the query controls in one panel.

entries.screen: Stacked bar with 16+ categories
entries.observation: A stacked bar with about a dozen segment hues per column and a legend that ends '+11 more'. A category filter list with toggles sits at the right.
entries.lesson: Cap at 8, fold the tail into Other. Offer the full list in a table.

entries.screen: Chart with breakdown table and view mode dialog
entries.observation: A chart with a toolbar (Anomaly + Forecast, Compare, Line chart, granularity, 7d, 30d, 60d, 90d), 'Data from 47 min ago', a legend, and a breakdown table beneath with checkboxes, segment, date columns and Export CSV.
entries.lesson: Toolbar in one row. Table beneath shares state with the chart. Show data age.

entries.screen: Funnel exploration with a table beneath
entries.observation: Step bars joined by pale connector areas, an abandonment rate under each step, and a table with step, active users, completion rate, abandonments and abandonment rate by device.
entries.lesson: A funnel is bars plus conversion between steps, backed by a table.

entries.screen: Purchase funnel with four hues and a 125% step
entries.observation: Four bars in purple, lavender, teal and green with step chips reading 17%, 125% and 80%.
entries.lesson: A step over 100 percent on small counts is a data artifact to guard, and a hue per stage should be one ordinal ramp.

entries.screen: Session outcome Sankey with Save chart and Export data
entries.observation: A Sankey with percentage labels at each node, beside a card toolbar of Save Chart, Export Data, a date range and a segment select.
entries.lesson: A Sankey is fine when flow between a handful of states is the question, and exports belong in the card.

entries.screen: Dark overview of six mini area charts
entries.observation: Six KPI plus area-chart tiles, no y-axis, a gradient under each line. Three are flat at zero, and a green arrow sits beside values of 0.
entries.lesson: Flat zero tiles with a positive arrow read as broken. Collapse empty tiles and don't show a direction arrow for 0 change.

entries.screen: Dark dashboard: KPI row then area chart
entries.observation: Three KPI tiles (total, paid, free members) with deltas, then a large area chart with a dotted crosshair and a tooltip with the value and date.
entries.lesson: KPI row then primary trend, with a crosshair tooltip. Works in dark mode.

entries.screen: Usage charts as step lines
entries.observation: CPU, RAM, network and volume as stepped purple lines with right-aligned labels, and a cost table beneath.
entries.lesson: State that holds between events (a volume size) is a step line, not a curve.

entries.screen: Overlapping translucent areas
entries.observation: Four translucent areas in orange, pink, purple and red overlap, creating blended third colors, over a dashed grid.
entries.lesson: Overlap of similar translucent hues reads as extra series. Stack, facet, or cut to two. Make the grid solid and quiet.

entries.screen: Spending trends stacked bars with a table
entries.observation: Two wide stacked columns in saturated blue, yellow, green and red, with an average dot and line, then a table of month, total and 'compared to average' with arrows.
entries.lesson: The comparison table with arrows is good. The thick saturated blocks are loud; cap the thickness and use the chart tokens.

entries.screen: KPI tabs with deltas and compare toggle
entries.observation: Four KPI tabs (value plus green delta), an 'Overview' chart of two lines (white and teal on dark), 'Compare bots' toggle and a 'vs. Previous Period' row.
entries.lesson: KPI tabs with deltas drive the chart; the comparison is a visible control.

entries.screen: Analysis with filters and a Table or Chart tab
entries.observation: A filter panel (tags, name, date range, channels with a checklist dropdown) above a Table | Chart tab strip and Individual, Count, Percentage toggles.
entries.lesson: Table and Chart as sibling tabs is the table twin. Filters sit once, above.

entries.screen: Page views with a two-month range picker
entries.observation: Presets (Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Last Month, This Month, Last 3 Months, Last 6 Months, Last Year) beside two calendars, Cancel and Apply, and a right filter panel with Apply.
entries.lesson: Presets left, calendar right, Apply and Cancel. Selected range is highlighted.

entries.screen: Analytics with a filter popover and Popular times
entries.observation: A Date range popover with preset select, From and To fields and Cancel and Apply. The Popular times card says 'Click on a bar to view details'.
entries.lesson: Tell the reader what clicking does.

entries.screen: Business performance summary with comparison
entries.observation: 'Jun 22, 2026 - Jul 22, 2026 compared to previous period' beside a Time period popover, a big number and a '0% vs. previous period' chip.
entries.lesson: Make the comparison period explicit in words and in a chip. Handle zero change with a neutral chip.

entries.screen: Dashboard range popover with preset chips
entries.observation: Preset chips (Yesterday, Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 365 days) above Start and End fields and two calendars, then Clear and Apply.
entries.lesson: Preset chips on top work as well as a left list. The selected range stays marked in the calendars.

entries.screen: Page views with a date range picker and freshness
entries.observation: A calendar with Last, Since, Between modes, a timezone select (UTC+00:00) and Apply, over a chart toolbar with 'Data from 47 min ago' and a refresh.
entries.lesson: Show the timezone in the picker and the age of the data next to the refresh.
